integrity: Analytic proof provided. Rational intertwining identities and independent high-precision finite heat/dual tests are corroboration, not proofs by enumeration of a continuum. Publication priority is qualified.
scientific_limitations: Other conductance patterns, heat normalizations, graph sizes, weighted metric lengths and multigraphs are not covered. An unindexed equivalent computation remains a priority risk.
scientific_scope: Unnormalized heat semigroup with one positive exceptional conductance on an unweighted-metric four-cycle; real Lipschitz seminorm modulo constants, counting vertex measure.
title: A one-edge conductance defect on the four-cycle: sharp heat-Lipschitz transition and amplification
